proposal.root_cause: Commit 38abaff32157775ddfefb5864b7ca4a70ed75922 introduced an invalid redis maxmemory-policy value (allkeys-lfu-max) in deploy/demo/redis.yaml, causing redis to exit with a fatal config error on startup (CrashLoopBackOff).
proposal.rationale: Pod redis-7d8d979d6c-26pwz is CrashLoopBackOff; previous container logs show 'FATAL CONFIG FILE ERROR ... maxmemory-policy "allkeys-lfu-max"' — 'allkeys-lfu-max' is not a valid eviction policy (valid: allkeys-lru, allkeys-lfu, allkeys-random, volatile-*, noeviction). Git history shows commit 38abaff32157775ddfefb5864b7ca4a70ed75922 changed the arg from 'allkeys-lru' to the invalid 'allkeys-lfu-max'. Reverting to the last known good value 'allkeys-lru' restores a config Redis accepts.
proposal.verify: After merge and Argo CD sync, the redis pod restarts cleanly with no FATAL CONFIG FILE ERROR in logs, container becomes Ready, and the redis Service endpoints populate on port 6379.
